output.reason: The evidence states that for a Tier 3 UCB, it “shall not levy any pre-payment charges” on floating rate business-purpose loans to individuals and MSEs where the sanctioned amount/limit is “up to ₹50 lakh.” This supports that the prohibition is limited to loans up to ₹50 lakh; therefore it would not extend to an ₹80 lakh loan (which exceeds ₹50 lakh).
